info.name: LMS mobile API v1
info.description:
Mobile app API.

1. Choose the environment and set base_url.
2. Run "Sign in and account → Login" (the token and library slug are saved automatically).
3. Every other request then works. Library requests use {{library}}; change it to use another library.

Errors are JSON: 401 signed out, 402 subscription needs attention, 403 no permission, 404 not found, 409 possible duplicate, 422 form error, 426 app update required, 429 too many requests.
Full guide: docs/mobile-api.md. Swagger: {{base_url}}/api/docs
